Overlapping caption cues

Failure signal

A overlapping caption cues condition is reported or detected during localization.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for localization does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Sort cue intervals and find any next start earlier than the current end.

Corrective action

Retiming cues while preserving minimum gaps, shot changes and spoken meaning.

Prevention

Add this verification to the localization gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
